description: CLINTON - Pledging to make Connecticut a more affordable place to live, work, and retire, former State Representative Charles Ferraro has filed papers to run as the Republican candidate for the 33rd Senate District. “From electricity bills to property taxes, we must do more to lower the cost of living in Connecticut,” Ferraro said. “In Hartford, I’ve proven I can work across the aisle to deliver a balanced, no-tax-increase budget while establishing strong fiscal guardrails on state spending and

title: Former State Rep. Charles Ferraro Files Papers to Run for 33rd District State Senate Seat
